items.q: This guy Ed Depappa had the club where… a small club on the north side where Eddie South was.

ctx.x: Yeah, Boyd Atkins. Al Capone had the Cotton Club on Cicero and then they begin to branch out. This guy Ed Depappa had the club where… a small club on the north side where Eddie South was. And Ralph Capone, Al Capone‟s brother opened a club downtown in Chicago.
